provenance: New illustrative examples authored with AI assistance for this project; not copied from an external corpus. This provenance is not a guarantee of exclusive rights or legal clearance.
purpose: Proposed miniature conversation/comprehension diagnostic, not general assistant training.
training_policy: Do not train without explicit content-hashed user review. No loader or training integration is supplied. No runtime answer lookup. Do not mix test answers into vocabulary construction, examples or optimizer selection.
evaluation_policy: Proposed frozen tests, not yet a locked independent test. Examples are visible to developers. Approve and hash the exact splits before experiments; use separate development examples for tuning. Preserve name spelling, conversational order, negation and corrections. Test more than expected-answer string matching before claiming understanding.
conversation_format: Ordered role/content turns. Predict assistant answer after all supplied turns. No role tokens are implemented by this draft.
